messages:
maria: Heads up — seeing a ~40-60% bump in p95 for host-side preflight parsing when traffic goes over HTTP/2 (grpc gateway change). Spike is concentrated on small requests (<200 tokens).

alex: I can repro on perf cluster. p95 jumps from ~12ms -> ~20-22ms for small frames. Flamegraph points at request_preflight::parse_headers and smallframe write path.

sam: interesting — any change to small-write coalescing or header handling recently? that encode_smallframe_writev smell sounds like microwrites.

maria: We flipped the gateway to multiplex and enabled header compression in the proxy last week. suspecting per-header allocations + extra framing calls.

alex: quick profile dump (top):
```
pprof -top preflight_cpu.prof
  35.2%  request_preflight::parse_headers
  22.1%  transport::encode_smallframe_writev
  10.4%  io::socket_writev
  6.8%   kv_cache::lookup (cold)
  3.7%   serde_json::from_slice
```

jen: Can we check batching heuristics? if micro-batching is off, we might be issuing lots of tiny writes which defeats kernel batching and nukes latency.

alex: good point — when microbatch disabled, calls to writev spike 3x. also KV cache coldhits show up in profile — parse path touching auth headers does a KV lookup which adds jitter.

leo: reproducer command i used:
```
wrk -t4 -c200 -d30s -s scripts/small-grpc-headers.lua http2://ingress:8443
```
results: p95 21.4ms, tail spikes aligned with cold KV shards.

sam: quick mitigation options:
- enable smallwrite coalesce in ingress proxy (mutexed but reduces syscall churn)
- prewarm KV shard for header auth on hot nodes
- switch header parser to pooled buffer -> cut allocs

alex: I put a tiny patch to coalesce small writes behind a feature flag. canaryed on one host: p95 down from 21.4ms -> 13.2ms for the same workload.

maria: awesome. any regression risk? how about interop with http2 flow control?

alex: tested for flow control; coalesce respects stream-level windows. main risk is increased latency for very small/high-frequency streams when autoscale is tight; toggleable.

jen: open followups:
- LU-# (ticket) to roll out smallwrite_coalesce across cluster with telemetry
- LU-# to pool header parse buffers and reduce mallocs (low-risk rewrite)
- measure interaction with kernel selection and batching (might be a separate perf test)

infra-bot: deploy 3912345681 by alex started to canary on host rdx-infer-03 :rocket:

leo: I also added a microbenchmark that exercises header parse + kv lookup and uploaded to /perf/artifacts/3912345678/small-preflight.tar.gz

maria: plan: roll coalesce to 10% -> 50% -> 100% with KV prewarm in parallel. I'll pair with SRE to watch p95 and cpu tail.

sam: note: kernel selection/batching may still amplify; let's run the kernel-selection perf matrix next (sequence lengths 8/32/128, batch sizes 1/8/32) after canary.

alex: ok — i'll publish canary metrics and open PR for buffer pooling. tagging @jen for rollout coordination. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks team — keeping this thread for triage notes.
